samples.question: The image shows several opaque light-gray square plates on a plain white background, all the same size and separated from one another by clear background. Each plate carries exactly four small coloured square ports, one flush against the middle of each of its four sides, and two thick dark bands drawn entirely inside that plate. On every plate the two bands join its four ports into two pairs: each band runs from one port to exactly one other port and the two bands never touch or cross. Exactly one plate in the image carries a green port; call it the wired plate, and ignore every other plate entirely. The wired plate's other three ports are one orange, one purple and one blue. Follow the dark band that leaves the green port and see which of those three ports it ends at. Which port does the band from the green port reach? Answer orange, purple or blue.
